snippet.title: Super Meat Boy 3D Announcement Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
As part of the Xbox June Showcase, Super Meat Boy, the infamous tough-as-nails platformer, was revealed, IN 3D! Coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Xbox Cloud.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/--/9NJ67TQQ51Z0
